task: Unified autoregressive framework decoupling visual encoding for multimodal understanding and visual generation in one Transformer architecture
methodological_commitments: Use a single causal/autoregressive Transformer interface over text and visual tokens
Decouple visual encoding into separate pathways suitable for understanding and generation instead of one shared visual encoder
Evaluate multimodal understanding on provided equation and Doge meme images
Evaluate visual generation at least by a text-to-image/token-generation proxy within the same autoregressive token interface
Compare decoupled visual encoding against a single visual encoder baseline
Include validation/comparison plots and evidence-backed report

available_data.role: meme semantic understanding and Figure 5-style semantic test

planned_fallbacks: No pretrained multimodal Transformer weights are provided; implement a transparent prototype/simulation with deterministic image encoders, OCR/text evidence, and autoregressive token accounting rather than claiming pretrained model performance.
